description: Kosciej Niesmiertelny, Koschei the Deathless, a tall skeletal old sorcerer-king with grey skin stretched over his bones, a long thin grey beard, a black iron crown, dark ornate armour and a long black cloak, glowing icy blue eyes, holding a long sword, menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the figure alone, no ground, no background, the whole figure and sword inside the picture
